cases.refreshed: This interactive photography exhibit showcases several musical instruments from the South Asian subcontinent. Scan a QR code to hear instruments played in Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. These stringed, wind, and percussion instruments have been passed down through generations and are still played around the Bay Area. Come and enjoy this exhibit, which starts on November 14, 2026, and closes on December 5, 2026. The exhibit is brought to you by the South Asians in Silicon Valley initiative at the SJSU King Library. Through this unique initiative, the SJSU King Library records, preserves, and shares the living legacy of the South Asian diaspora in the San Francisco Bay Area. Website: https://library.sjsu.edu/sasv
